name: China Railway Signal & Communication Corporation Limited
summary: China Railway Signal & Communication Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides rail transportation control system solutions in China and internationally. It operates through Rail Transportation Control System, General Engineering Contracting, and Others segments. The company offers design and integration, and system integration services for rail transportation control system-related products; and design and consulting services for rail transportation projects. It also produces and sells signal system products, communication information system products, infrastructure equipment and information systems, and other related products.
